title: Weak Identification in Bunching Designs: Rare Events and Counterfactual Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.40719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study shrinking tax kinks when the counterfactual density is locally H\"older continuous and may be accompanied by a known background atom at the threshold. Small policy incentives create two distinct obstacles: few behavioral bunchers and an unobserved relocation interval. For the complete observed distribution, we establish matching minimax bounds for elasticity estimation and honest confidence-set diameter. With kink size $d$, background mass $\gamma$, and smoothness $0<s\leq1$, the rate is $\min\{1,\sqrt{(\gamma+d)/(nd^2)}+d^s\}$. The stochastic component has a rare-event scale when the background mass is of the kink order or smaller and a conventional weak-signal scale when it remains positive. The extrapolation component follows from observationally equivalent counterfactual densities, rather than sampling error. We derive normal and Poisson limits for a conventional bunching ratio, show a coverage failure of its Wald interval,

translated_title: 聚束设计中的弱识别：稀有事件与反事实不确定性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当反事实密度局部Hölder连续且可能在阈值处伴随一个已知背景原子时逐渐缩小的税收拐点。较小的政策激励造成两个不同的障碍：行为聚束者稀少以及一个未被观测到的迁移区间。对于完整的观测分布，我们为弹性估计和诚实置信集直径建立了匹配的极小极大界。当拐点大小为 $d$、背景质量为 $\gamma$、光滑度为 $0<s\leq1$ 时，收敛率为 $\min\{1,\sqrt{(\gamma+d)/(nd^2)}+d^s\}$。当背景质量与拐点同阶或更小时，随机成分呈现稀有事件尺度；当背景质量保持为正时，则呈现常规的弱信号尺度。外推成分源于观测等价的反事实密度，而非抽样误差。我们推导了常规聚束比率的正态极限和泊松极限，并展示了其Wald区间的覆盖率失效。
tldr: 该论文研究了聚束设计中政策激励较小时弹性估计的弱识别问题，建立了匹配的极小极大界，揭示了稀有事件随机误差与观测等价反事实密度外推不确定性这两类不同的困难来源。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes matching minimax bounds for elasticity estimation in bunching designs under small policy incentives, revealing two distinct identification obstacles: a rare-event scale in sampling error and uncertainty arising from observationally equivalent counterfactual densities.
